name: dev-1310-han-only-links
title: DEV-1310 — zero-token/Han-only brands with legacy first-eligible purchase websites
subtitle: Seventeen approved brands whose name yields zero Latin tokens, so the hostname identity check could not run and deriveOfficialWebsite fell back to first-eligible. Each purchase_website below was scored offline against fetched page evidence and returned a high-confidence not-owned verdict: shopping malls (iopenmall), business directories (iyp.com.tw x2), a government e-commerce platform, a crowdfunding page, a price-comparison site, Behance, OpenRice, and a media site. Seven further brands were UNSCOREABLE (403/503/no text captured) and are deliberately excluded — a site that could not be judged is not a site judged wrong. DEV-1310 Task 7 shipped first, so cleared rows are not re-derived on the next curation sweep. 'Tw' and '專業研發、雙認證工廠製作' are DEV-1321 mangled-name rows: the link is cleared here, the name is not.
